search_text:
若 $\Omega$ 是由 $1\leq z\leq\sqrt{2-x^2-y^2}$ 决定的闭区域，则 $\iiint_\Omega\frac1{x^2+y^2+z^2}dv=$（ ） $2\sqrt2\pi$ $\pi\ln2$ $2\sqrt2-\ln2$ $(2\sqrt2-2-\ln2)\pi$ $$
\Omega\text{即}\left\{\begin{array}{l}
0\leq\theta\leq2\pi\\
0\leq\varphi\leq\frac{\pi}{4}\\
\frac{1}{\cos\varphi}\leq r\leq\sqrt{2}
\end{array}\right.,\quad\text{于是}
$$
原式
$$
=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_{\frac{1}{\cos\varphi}}^{\sqrt{2}}\frac{1}{r^2}r^2\sin\varphi\,dr=2\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(\sqrt{2}\sin\varphi-\tan\varphi)\,d\varphi
$$
$$
=2\pi\cdot(-\sqrt{2}\cos\varphi+\ln\cos\varphi)\bigg|_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}=(2\sqrt{2}-2-\ln2)\pi.
$$
